gaps.lead: She found it hard to understand the accent.
gaps.explanation: 'Have difficulty (in) doing' = find it hard to do.

gaps.lead: I'm sure Jemma is going to become a famous model one day.
gaps.sentence: I think it's only ___ Jemma becomes a famous model.
gaps.explanation: 'It's only a matter of time before' means it will definitely happen eventually.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.

gaps.lead: 'We are closing the factory,' the board announced.
gaps.sentence: The board announced that ___ the factory.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were closing.

gaps.lead: She was made to wait for two hours.
gaps.explanation: 'Was made to wait' has the same meaning as 'had to wait'.
